approval_evidence.quote: NDA 209884 NDA APPROVAL ... Mayzent (siponimod) tablets ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter

series_end_reason: From the 2024Q1 report onward Novartis prints no Mayzent line (searched: the label does not occur anywhere in the 2024Q1-2026Q2 results documents).
notes: Approved FDA March 2019. 2019Q2 value 5 is the prior-year column of the Q2 2020 report (six months 2019 also 5, so Q1 2019 nil); Q2 2019 own report prints no Mayzent sales. No document found stating launch quarter.
search_log: Listed all 6-K/6-K/A/20-F/20-F/A filings for CIK 1114448 (data.sec.gov submissions incl. older page, 2010-10 to 2026-09; 454 filings), fetched index.json of every 6-K from 2012 on and identified the results exhibit (EX-99.2 interim financial report) for each quarter 2010Q3-2026Q2 (64 documents)

Parsed every table row of each of the 64 results documents and extracted the row labelled with the brand; compared each quarter's own value against the next year's prior-year column: no restatement difference found for any of these brands
No Sandoz/Alcon spin-off restatement affected these lines as printed: own-quarter values equal the later prior-year columns
Q2 2019 report prints Mayzent only in the approvals table

launch_evidence.quote: Mayzent (siponimod) launched for RMS including active secondary progressive MS (SPMS)
